name: Shadowshard Fragments

faq.answer: Uthel'nay awaits in the city of Orgrimmar, seeking fragments brought back from Maraudon.
Shadowshard Fragments are found deep within Maraudon.
faq.q: Where do the Shadowshard Fragments come from?

faq.answer: Uthel'nay requires ten Shadowshard Fragments brought to Orgrimmar.
faq.q: How many Shadowshard Fragments are needed?

sections.body: Maraudon holds the crystalline shards Uthel'nay desires. Gathering ten of these pieces will require venturing into the caverns before carrying them back to the Orc capital.
sections.title: The Shards of Maraudon

summary: Uthel'nay in Orgrimmar seeks ten Shadowshard Fragments from within Maraudon. You are asked to gather these mineral remnants from the caverns and return to the Horde capital.
